name: Yusuf
self_text: I’m a young Mexican photographer in my early 20s, shooting with a Nikon. I love climbing, and I’m looking for a structured instruction session—just the shooting, no post‑processing lesson this time. We’ll focus on the camera work, and we’re not taking portraits of each other. I’m free Sunday afternoon if that works for you.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with not taking portraits of each other, you must not insist on doing so. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Sunday afternoon, though it's not a requirement if you can make it work another time. A nice bonus would be if you are into a structured instruction session, but that's just a small preference.
